lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace E] [inst_4 : BorelSpace E] {V : E → ℝ} {α β : NNReal} {η : ℝ},
  0 < ↑α →
    α ≤ β →
      ContDiff ℝ 2 V →
        (∀ (x v : E), ↑α * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x) v) v ∧ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x) v) v ≤ ↑β * ‖v‖ ^ 2) →
          0 < η →
            ↑β * η ≤ 1 →
              have μ := MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.tilted fun x => -V x;
              have J :=
                MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p => (p.1, p.1 + √η • p.2)) (μ.prod (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E));
              have W := fun y u => V ((1 / 2) • (y + u)) + ‖u - y‖ ^ 2 / (8 * η);
              have s := fun y u => -(1 / 2) • fderiv ℝ V ((1 / 2) • (y + u)) - (1 / (4 * η)) • (innerSL ℝ) (y - u);
              ∃ R S,
                ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel R ∧
                  ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel S ∧
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.map Prod.swap J).IsCondKernel R ∧
                      (∀ (y : E), S y = MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => 2 • x - y) (R y)) ∧
                        ∀ (y : E),
                          (S y = MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.tilted fun u => -W y u) ∧
                            ContDiff ℝ 2 (W y) ∧
                              ContDiff ℝ 1 (s y) ∧
                                (∀ (u v w : E),
                                    ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (W y)) u) v) w =
                                        1 / 4 * ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) ((1 / 2) • (y + u))) v) w +
                                          1 / (4 * η) * Inner.inner ℝ v w ∧
                                      ((fderiv ℝ (s y) u) v) w =
                                        1 / (4 * η) * Inner.inner ℝ v w -
                                          1 / 4 * ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) ((1 / 2) • (y + u))) v) w) ∧
                                  (∀ (u v : E), (↑α + 1 / η) / 4 * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (W y)) u) v) v) ∧
                                    (∀ (u : E), ‖fderiv ℝ (s y) u‖ ≤ (1 / η - ↑α) / 4) ∧
                                      ∀ (a : E),
                                        (ContDiff ℝ 1 fun u => (s y u) a) ∧
                                          MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun u => (s y u) a) 2 (S y) ∧
                                            (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.Poincare.Admissible
                                                (S y) fun u => (s y u) a) ∧
                                              ∀ (u : E), ‖gradient (fun z => (s y z) a) u‖ ≤ (1 / η - ↑α) / 4 * ‖a‖
approved_definition_context: Measure.map is pushforward, Measure.prod independent product, stdGaussian standard Gaussian and volume canonical Lebesgue measure. A tilt is normalized exponential weighting.
A Markov kernel is a measurably parameterized probability measure. M.IsCondKernel R disintegrates joint M conditional on its first coordinate. Prod.swap exchanges the coordinates.

ContDiff at order one or two is C1 or C2. fderiv is the actual Frechet derivative; iterated fderiv is the bilinear second derivative. innerSL is the inner product as a continuous linear functional in its second argument. gradient is the Riesz inverse of fderiv.
MemLp at exponent two means an almost-everywhere strongly measurable function with finite L2 seminorm. Bochner Integrable includes measurability and finite integral of the norm.

The Admissible predicate in the displayed namespace is exactly Integrable q mu AND Integrable (fun x => (q x - integral q dmu)^2) mu AND Integrable (fun x => norm(gradient q x)^2) mu. It does not contain a variance inequality.
Operator norms are norms of continuous linear maps. Local lets abbreviate explicitly defined objects, not extra hypotheses.
